question: How many players from one team are allowed on the basketball court during play?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In basketball, each team is allowed to have **5 players** on the court during play.
 
• This includes positions such as point guard, shooting guard, small forward, power forward, and center.
 
• Teams can substitute players during stoppages, but at no time can there be more than **5 players** from a team on the court.
 
• Having more than 5 players on the court results in a technical foul against the team.
 
• The rule of 5 players ensures a balanced and fair competition in accordance with **official basketball regulations**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Basketball Court Dimensions:** A standard basketball court measures 28 meters in length and 15 meters in width, as per FIBA regulations.
 
• **Game Duration:** Professional basketball games are divided into four quarters, each lasting 12 minutes in the NBA or 10 minutes in FIBA.
 
• **Team Composition:** A basketball team typically consists of 12 players, with 5 on the court and 7 substitutes on the bench.
 
• **Substitution Rules:** Substitutions can occur during stoppages in play, but they must be approved by the referee.
 
• **Technical Fouls:** A technical foul is awarded for violations such as having too many players on the court, improper conduct, or delay of game.
